title: Sections of the restricted associated-sheaf complex
statement: For a commutative ring R, an open W of Spec R and any nonnegative cochain complex K of R-modules, the abelian-group complex obtained by applying [new-punctured-restricted-abelian-functor] degreewise and taking global sections on W is isomorphic to the underlying abelian-group complex of puncturedSectionsComplex R W K [def-sbc-punctured-sections-complex].

source.place: Tags 01I6 and 0A6T; associated sheaves, restriction and exactness

proof.text: In each degree use the original abelian presheaf map along the equality W.ι_image_top. Both sides have the same underlying section groups after forgetting scalars. Naturality of the sheaf map of each differential proves the chain-map condition, so HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents gives the isomorphism. This proof is complete and applies to arbitrary K, including the zero complex and empty W.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_tilde_sections_comparison
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) :
    let Γ := sheafToPresheaf
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology W.toScheme.carrier)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙ (evaluation _ _).obj (op ⊤)
    Nonempty (((Γ.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
      (((puncturedRestrictedAbelianFunctor R W).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K)) ≅
      (((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (puncturedSectionsComplex R W K)))
